sourceNote: Five Guys Deutschland publishes one PDF, "Allergen-and-Nutrition-Info.pdf" (four pages, made with PDF24 on 15 June 2026): an allergen table, a table of raw materials valid in Germany only, and on pages 3 and 4 "Nährwertangaben – Five Guys Deutschland" (FGDE, 15/06/2026), which states per portion and per 100 g: energy in kJ and kcal, fat, saturated fat, carbohydrate, sugar, fibre, protein and salt, but no portion weight. The sheet lists a burger, a hot dog and a shake by their parts (patty, bun, bacon, toppings, sauces, mix-ins), which the file leaves under excluded, and the complete items people order: the fries in four sizes, curry style and loaded fries, the veggie sandwiches, grilled cheese, the BLT, the burger in a lettuce wrap, the plain milkshake in two sizes and the free peanuts. With no stated weight, an item is one portion with the chain's per-portion values; the peanuts, which the sheet states per 100 g only, are per 100 g. The sheet says the values are representative figures from suppliers, public sources or industry-standard software and accredited laboratories, and that hand-made portions vary.
sha256Note: SHA-256 of the PDF as downloaded; every row comes from its pages 3 and 4.
